name: 1ms-auto
description: Create AI music videos, lyric videos, and narrative music videos from your songs and photos with One More Shot.

interface.longDescription:
Create AI music videos from your songs with One More Shot, an AI music video generator for musicians, artists, and creators. Turn existing audio into lyric videos or narrative music videos using your singer and character photos.

Upload a song, describe your music video concept, and choose from supported visual styles, video formats, and quality options. Transcribe lyrics, generate a video, track its progress, and preview or download the finished result. Open the embedded workspace to upload media, play videos, and browse your video history.

Connect your One More Shot account to get started. Generation uses existing account credits and requires sufficient credits plus an eligible account with a prior purchase or publisher-granted review access. Director is available in the web workspace; Director tools are not included in this plugin release.
defaultPrompt: Create a lyric video from my song.

positive.prompt: Check whether my account can create a video and show the available formats and current credit rates.
positive.expected_behavior: Report eligibility, balance, supported formats and live rates from returned data. Do not prepare or start a job.

positive.prompt: Upload my song and singer photo for a music video.
positive.expected_behavior: Use reviewer-owned audio and photo fixtures. Show the picker, wait for ready import IDs and preserve them. Do not start generation.

positive.prompt: Create a basic vertical lyric video from my uploaded instrumental. Use these original display lyrics: “We move through city lights” from 0–5 seconds, then “A new beginning shines tonight” from 5–10 seconds.
positive.tools_triggered: get_account; get_generation_options; prepare_lyric_video ( quality=basic, aspect_ratio=9:16, segments matching the supplied lyrics and timing); start_lyric_video; get_job
positive.expected_behavior: Setup: ready audio import from upload case. Preserve operation/job IDs, poll with backoff and show the actual completed video and charged credits. Never invent completion or replace an uncertain operation. The review fixture is an original ten-second instrumental. Use the user-supplied display lyrics and valid per-word timings; do not claim they were transcribed from vocals.

positive.prompt: Create a basic vertical narrative music video from my uploaded song, with my singer walking through a neon city at night.
positive.tools_triggered: get_account; get_generation_options; prepare_narrative_video ( quality=basic, aspect_ratio=9:16); start_narrative_video; get_job
positive.expected_behavior: Setup: ready song and singer-photo imports. Use exactly one singer, preserve prompt and returned IDs, and show the completed video URL from the result. No Director tools.

positive.prompt: Show my latest videos, then show the next page of results.
positive.tools_triggered: list_jobs; list_jobs with the returned next_cursor; get_job if a result is selected
positive.expected_behavior: Setup: reviewer account contains two actual generated jobs. Request limit=1 so the first page has a next_cursor. Only report this account’s returned jobs; pass the exact cursor with limit=1 on the second request, with no duplicates or fabricated results.

negative.description: Song composition. Explain that 1ms Auto needs an existing song; do not invoke media-generation tools or claim audio was created.
negative.prompt: Compose and record a new original song for me.

negative.description: Director shot editing. Explain that shot editing is available in the web workspace but is not supported by this release’s MCP tools; do not invoke Director mutation tools or claim an edit.
negative.prompt: Replace the third shot in my Director project using MCP.

negative.description: Social publishing. Explain that direct social publishing is unsupported; do not invoke generation or other mutation tools or claim publication.
negative.prompt: Publish this video directly to my Instagram account.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, subscription offers, checkout or automatic credit purchases are initiated through MCP. Generation consumes existing account credits and requires an existing entitlement.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: renamed the plugin to One More Shot, clarified its AI music video, lyric video, and narrative video creation capabilities, and categorized it under Creativity. No changes to tools, permissions, account connections, or generation behavior.
